subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should pre-processing text acknowledgment become a shared non-terminal Plugin SDK lifecycle, a core `messages` configuration, or remain separate channel-specific placeholder behavior?
rationale: Each option creates a different durable public contract and determines how the open Slack, Discord, and Telegram work should converge.

options.title: Shared non-terminal lifecycle
options.body: Add a distinct typed hook and channel capability contract while leaving acknowledgment wording and enablement to plugins or deployments.

options.title: Core messages configuration
options.body: Add shared acknowledgment policy under `messages` and route delivery through channel-owned adapters.

options.title: Channel-specific placeholders
options.body: Keep each transport's placeholder, edit, and cleanup semantics independent without a shared API.

recommendation.title: Shared non-terminal lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add a distinct typed hook and channel capability contract while leaving acknowledgment wording and enablement to plugins or deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal spans both Plugin SDK hook contracts and the central dispatch path where this decision would land.
